description: This file defines an Angular service called DisplaysService that manages device display visibility states, subscribes to device data streams, and provides methods to toggle and retrieve device display information.

classes.name: DisplaysService
classes.description: An Angular service that manages device display visibility and emits updates related to device display info.

methods.name: toggleVisibility
methods.description: Toggles the visibility state of a device based on its deviceId.

methods.name: isVisibleDevice
methods.description: Checks whether a device with given display id is currently visible.

methods.name: getDeviceVisibilities
methods.description: Returns an observable stream of device visibility information.

methods.name: getDisplayInfoChanged
methods.description: Provides an observable that emits when display information changes.

methods.name: onDeviceDisplayInfo
methods.description: Handles incoming device display information updates and emits change events.

methods.name: addToVisibleDevices
methods.description: Adds a device to the list of visible devices if not already present.

methods.name: removeFromVisibleDevices
methods.description: Removes a device from the list of visible devices.
